reviews.title: only 5 stars so you WILL LISTEN
reviews.text: This app absolutely sucked. Even though I kinda didn't need it, I got bored and decided to test out sticker apps :3! but then, no matter how much I opened the app, it immediately crashed. I thought this would be a good and fun app, but I immediately deleted it. This would've been a one star, and please fix your app, thank you! :D
